title: Instagram Story Video Maker | AIVideosUGC
description: Turn a product link into an Instagram Story video with an avatar, a script, and a voice. Export the tall file and post it on Instagram Stories.
h1: Turn a Product Link Into an Instagram Story Video
lead: Start with a hot sauce link or one bottle photo. You get an avatar and a voice in a tall Instagram Story video. The bottle in the file is the one you ship.
steps_h2: How to Make a Square Story Image in 3 Simple Steps
steps_lead: You get a tall Story video of the hot sauce, with an avatar and a voice, ready to post.

steps.d: Use the photo where the whole hot sauce bottle is visible. That photo is the product in the Story video.
Pick an avatar to hold the hot sauce and say one line about the heat. Set the voice before you export.
Download the tall Story video and post it. The bottle stays full in frame, with no watermark.

faq.q: What is a Story video template for a product?
faq.a: A Story ad template is a tall video for the hot sauce, with an avatar and a voice. The bottle stays fully visible, and you skip filming a new clip just to fill that frame. When you need another motion style, start from [creator-style video ads](page:video-ads).

faq.q: How does a Story template become a video I can post?
faq.a: You leave with a tall Story video you can post. Add the hot sauce photo, say the price in the script, and download.

faq.q: Why use a template instead of filming a creator for Stories?
faq.a: Stories go stale when the offer changes and the creator is booked. Change the spoken line and post the new Story video while that booking is still ahead.

faq.q: Who should make a Story video from this template?
faq.a: A shop that posts Stories every week, and the person who writes those posts. A hot sauce brand and the helper who handles its Instagram both need the bottle fully in the video.

faq.q: Can a beginner make a Story video this way?
faq.a: Yes. Someone who has never edited a video can still do it. The three steps turn one sharp photo into a Story video, and you add the price after you download.

faq.q: Which shops post this kind of Story video?
faq.a: Shops that sell something a viewer should see in full. Hot sauce, a small pouch, and a folded scarf can each become a Story video, with the price added after download.

faq.q: Can the Story use the photo I already shot for the shop?
faq.a: Yes. The hot sauce in the video should be the hot sauce you ship, label and all. Your logo can be added after download, and you do not need a new shoot for that.

faq.q: Which apps can I post this Story video to?
faq.a: Instagram Stories is the home for this tall video. A Facebook Story can use the same file, and a feed post can use a square cut. Use 16:9, 4:3, or 3:4 only when the placement is no longer a Story.

faq.q: Do I need a paid plan for a Story video template?
faq.a: Yes. Starter is $24.50 a month with 200 credits, Pro is $35 with 300, and Premium is $63 with 600. Each photo is 24 credits. A video is 24, 40, 60, or 120 credits for 6, 10, 15, or 30 seconds. You see the cost first. A failed run returns the credits. The download has no watermark.

faq.q: Can I run the Story video as a paid ad or client work?
faq.a: Yes. Run it as a paid Story, leave it as an organic post, or send the video to a client who sells the same hot sauce.

faq.q: Why use a Story template instead of building the video from scratch?
faq.a: Your time goes into the price and the heat, which are the words shoppers hear. The hot sauce already has a place in the video, so you can spend the edit on those words.

output: Tall Story video with an avatar and a voice
